movies.title: Kalki 2898 AD
movies.description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world in the year 2898 AD, a select few embark on a perilous mission to protect laboratory subject SUM-80 and her unborn child, believed to be the tenth avatar of Vishnu, Kalki. Starring Prabhas as Bhairava and Amitabh Bachchan as Ashwatthama.

movies.title: Jawan
movies.description: A high-octane emotional action thriller that outlines the journey of a man driven by a personal vendetta to rectify the wrongs in society, while keeping a promise made years ago. A massive box-office spectacle directed by Atlee.

movies.title: Stree 2: Sarkate Ka Aatank
movies.description: After the events of Stree, the town of Chanderi is haunted by a new menace known as Sarkata who abducts progressive women. Vicky and his loyal gang must team up with the mysterious protector spirit to defeat the malevolent entity.

movies.title: Animal
movies.description: A ferocious, complex drama exploring the volatile relationship between a son and his emotionally aloof industrialist father that erupts into ruthless underworld violence when an assassination attempt threatens his father.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.description: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, he endeavors to prevent a terrible future.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.description: Christopher Nolans Academy Award-winning masterpiece detailing the life of theoretical physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer, the director of the Manhattan Projects Los Alamos Laboratory during World War II.

movies.title: RRR
movies.description: A fictional story about two legendary Indian revolutionaries, Alluri Sitarama Raju and Komaram Bheem, and their fight against the British Raj in 1920. Winner of the Academy Award for Best Original Song.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.description: In Earths future, a global crop blight and second Dust Bowl are slowly rendering the planet uninhabitable. A team of astronauts travel through a wormhole near Saturn in search of a new home for mankind.

movies.title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
movies.description: The unstoppable rise of Pushpa Raj in the smuggling syndicate continues, bringing him into direct, merciless conflict with SP Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat in an explosive clash of wills and firepower.

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame
movies.description: After the devastating cosmic snap by Thanos wiped out half of all life, the remaining Avengers assemble one final time for the ultimate time heist to restore the universe.
